images.title: A circle in 8 equal parts and the straw
images.purpose: Show the circle folded into 8 equal parts with the straw turning 5 parts and then 2 more parts, so that the turn is 5/8 and then 7/8, with 1 more part to a full turn.
images.composition: One large disc on the left with the straw at the start point A and two curved arrows, and the sums written on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. DISC, centre (470, 410): a circle 520 px across with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (5 px) and a pale cream #FFF8E7 fill, cut by exactly 8 thin grey #6B7280 fold lines through the centre-to-rim, one every 45 steps of the circle, so that there are exactly 8 equal parts; the first fold line goes to the right (3 o'clock). The starting point A is a teal #0072B2 dot 28 px across on the rim at the right end of the first fold line, with the letter A (40 px, bold, dark) just outside it. The rim marks are numbered 1 to 7 going round anti-clockwise from A, in dark sans-serif (30 px) just outside the rim. The straw is a teal line (10 px) from the centre to A and an amber #E69F00 line (10 px) from the centre to the rim mark 5. The sector between A and mark 5 is filled pale amber (35 percent opaque); the sector between mark 5 and mark 7 is filled pale reddish purple #CC79A7 (35 percent opaque). Two curved arrows with arrowheads on a circle of radius 330 px outside the labels: an amber arrow from A to mark 5, and a reddish purple arrow from mark 5 to mark 7. RIGHT SIDE: four lines of dark bold text (50 px) left aligned at x 880: 5 parts = 5/8 at y 250, 2 more parts = 2/8 at y 330, 5/8 + 2/8 = 7/8 at y 440, and, smaller (38 px) at y 530, 1 more part makes a full turn. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: 1 more part makes a full turn

images.takeaway: On a circle in 8 equal parts, 5 parts and 2 more parts make a 7/8 turn, and 1 more part makes a full turn.
images.description: A circle folded into 8 equal parts with the straw on A, turned 5 parts and then 2 more parts, and 5/8 + 2/8 = 7/8 written beside it.
images.context: Concept image for Measuring Turns in Eighths. It follows the idea of the tracing-paper circle with 8 equal parts, a straw and the starting point A in your maths book, and shows the concept's own example of 5 parts and then 2 more.
images.teaching_notes: Count the parts with the student before reading the fraction. The slip to watch is thinking 1/8 is bigger than 1/4 because 8 is bigger than 4.

image_decisions.why: The circle in 8 equal parts with the straw turned 5 parts and then 2 more shows each part as a 1/8 turn and how they add.
